dependency: Task 198 runner output, port 8012 eighteen-row proof and GitHub remote readback must exist before any Task 200 automation or queue contract is created.
geometry_policy: No new coordinates, polygons, building footprints or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Every selected row remains NOT_BOUND.

features.name: The Oracle, Reading
features.official_source_evidence: The official Oracle site presents Shop, Eat and Drink, See and Do and Plan Your Visit functions, describes major brands, riverside restaurants and cinema or cultural activity, and identifies the destination as Reading's riverside centre.
features.classification_finding: Retail Property is strongly supported. Exact geometry must represent the shopping-centre complex and exclude neighbouring Broad Street properties and unrelated riverside parcels.

features.name: GLP G-Park Biggleswade
features.official_source_evidence: GLP is the authoritative logistics-real-estate owner and developer source. Published property evidence identifies G-Park Biggleswade as a logistics and warehouse development, but the exact live site page must be locked before publication.
features.classification_finding: Industrial use is supported, but G-Park is a development containing one or more logistics buildings rather than a guaranteed single Industrial Unit. A named unit or exact industrial parcel is required.

features.name: Mountpark Bardon
features.official_source_evidence: Mountpark is the primary logistics-development source. Published property material identifies the Bardon location with large warehouse and distribution accommodation; an exact current Bardon property page remains required for source locking.
features.classification_finding: Industrial and logistics use is supported, but the named development may include multiple warehouse plots or buildings. One named unit or exact parcel must be selected before geometry binding.

features.name: Deansgate Square
features.official_source_evidence: The official New Jackson and Deansgate Square site records completion of Deansgate Square and identifies four residential towers with 1,508 apartments.
features.classification_finding: Residential apartment use is authoritative, but Deansgate Square is a four-tower cluster rather than one Apartment Building. One named tower must be selected before exact geometry binding.

features.name: 70 St Mary Axe
features.official_source_evidence: The official building site describes 70 St Mary Axe as a modern business building with workspaces, office floorplans, office specifications, amenities and leasing contacts.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is strongly supported and the named entity is one building. Exact footprint evidence remains mandatory, but no property-type or scope conflict is present.

features.name: SEGRO Logistics Park Northampton
features.official_source_evidence: SEGRO is the authoritative operator and developer source for the Northampton logistics park. Current published evidence identifies a strategic logistics development with multiple warehouse buildings and occupier plots.
features.classification_finding: Industrial and logistics use is supported, but the strategic park is not one Industrial Unit. A named warehouse or exact industrial parcel is required before geometry binding.
